headline: Field evidence of benefit over natural recovery: planting (after mechanical cleanup) (edge loss avoided by year 8 8.7 m (90% 2.5 to 15.1)); manual_removal (vegetation cover ratio gain at year 2 0.36 (90% 0.20 to 0.52)). Differences are experimental composer output from one site's field evidence.
scope_message: Heavily oiled salt marsh in the northern Gulf of Mexico: the marsh-edge loss model and the soil PAH-sum decline are validated (held-out, one spill). Treatment differences (composer) and the vegetation curve are experimental and carry that badge.
